description: The product host (operating/host.py) over one persistent state directory: two completed capture cycles, each by a new host process object on the same directory (a restart between cycles), with a cycle between them run as a child `operating.host run` process SIGKILLed after 30 s while its cycle is running, over the GET-only capture modules (Portal mirror with its persisted copy, BC purchaseOrders, the purchase-order inbox, the whole QCQA library with a 1000 s capture budget per cycle whose cut walk resumes in the next cycle), each followed by the incremental projection build with the one post-project step list (operating/build_steps.py: document mentions and document-field links through the identifier index and the reviewed aliases, reviewed links, confirmed kinds; the review store a build input). Before the killed cycle a probe case is opened through the served tools (an interpretation finding, a fact citing a readable projected object) and claimed (the case-claim lease), and after the last cycle it is re-read through new served tools. Asserted: both cycles ran and every cycle's build ran each of the four steps, exactly the killed cycle interrupted (a child that finished before the kill fails), the cycle after it complete on the last committed generation with no mail folder restarted, the probe case chain intact with both findings readable, citations current, no event lost or added, the claim still held and nothing for a principal without a grant, the one plx.act intent parked on the probe case before the kill (test mode only: an isolated owner, never a PLX system) still proposed after the restart with its event chain verified, never dispatched and with no approval, and the same case, its claim and that intent re-read after the restart through a new served session as a second permitted employee (the config's case_coworker: the probe case is opened for a group with the capture principal, the co-worker's principals hold the group, a principal outside it gets not found) with the case and intent chains verified, the intent proposed with no approval, and what the co-worker may not read counted as withheld markers, every configured source ran, the projection chains generation 1 -> 2 and the second cycle rebuilds fewer units than the cold first, no projected value in the output, and the projection read as a principal without any grant shows 0 objects and leaks nothing on a sample. Counts, states and codes only.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it (GET only; the OAuth token POSTs are the guard's only non-GETs). Replaces ingest.worker_cycles and ingest.live_sources (the legacy operating/ingest_worker.py store): exit 0 and both cycles ran (worker cycles >= 2, stopped max_cycles), no interrupted cycle (status.runs.interrupted / worker.interrupted 0), every configured source ran (summary.never_run 0; sources_configured 4 Portal/BC/mail/SharePoint instead of 6 units), the second cycle follows stored cursors (cursor_regressions 0: mail folders resume their deltaLink, mail_folders_restarted 0; BC modified-since; the projection chains and rebuilds fewer units) and no row data in the output (row_data_check.leaked 0, now over the projection the host serves). New: the persistent state directory across a restart, and the projection trimmed per reader (a principal without grant sees 0 objects). While the Portal API is down (since 2026-10-03) the first cycle has no persisted copy, the Portal source fails with live_source_unavailable:missing_mirror and is listed in blocked_upstream; the check is then blocked, never pass, and expect_blocked still asserts every other source, the projection, the trim and the leak check. Recorded, not asserted: per-source completeness (complete_when), BC modes and caps, SharePoint and mail counts. The AGENTS use-case folder stays with ingest.use_cases (operating.use_case_intake). Interrupt (EXE-06, ER-08, ING-15; AGT-03's live run of the case claim): interrupt.state is killed_running only when the child's cycle row was still running at the SIGKILL; finished_before_kill (the cycle outran 30 s) and killed_before_cycle fail the check, never pass. While blocked the cycle after the kill fails on the blocked source, so expect_blocked does not assert checks.resumed_after_interrupt; it still asserts the interrupt and the case resume. Co-worker resume (EXE-06, AGT-02): examples/host.live-check.json configures case_coworker (group:host-check-case, staff:host-check-coworker; example principals, no source grant), so case_resume.coworker_read/coworker_chain_ok are true, coworker_intent_state proposed and coworker_approval_state none (the isolated owner's fixture records are read by the group), and coworker_withheld_markers (recorded, not asserted) counts the case items the co-worker has no grant for (expected 1: the fact citing a capture-principal object).
